summary: Lake County, OR 25-ft L-4 tower; sources give 1933 or 1940 as the build year; replaced by a Crane Mountain tower in 1952 and gone by 1953.

facts.design: 25-foot L-4 trestle-type tower with 3 rows of 3 legs, L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Tower came down in 1953 (destroyed per the register and firelookout.com; removed per the Oregon lookouts site) after a 1952 replacement on Crane Mountain; no source describes the site today

staffing.status: staffed as a fire-weather station from 1940; observers not named

access.note: No source read says whether the site is open to the public

events.note: Material for the lookout reported as already purchased in a Lake County Examiner item dated November 24, 1932 (quoted by the Oregon lookouts site)
25-foot timber trestle tower with L-4 cab completed (Oregon lookouts site). Register and firelookout.com give 1940 instead; see resolved_conflicts

Register and firelookout.com date the tower to 1940; the Oregon lookouts site says the lookout was established as a fire-weather station that year, with observations phoned to the Lakeview Ranger Station
New 10-foot tower on Crane Mountain, about one mile west, replaced the Willow Point lookout; the garage moved to the new site
Register and firelookout.com say destroyed; Oregon lookouts site says 'The tower removed.'
Register says 'It was removed in 1972'; firelookout.com says 'It was destroyed in 1972'. Neither names the structure

evidence.supports: register: earlier 20-foot wooden tower in the 1930s; this 25-foot L-4 tower built in 1940, destroyed in 1953 after a 1952 replacement on Crane Mountain
evidence.quote: Preceded by a 20' wooden tower and ground cabin in the 1930s, this 25' L-4 trestle type tower with 3 rows of 3 legs, built in 1940, was destroyed in 1953 after being replaced by a 10' L-4 tower atop Crane Mountain 1 mile west in 1952.

register: 1972 removal date with no structure named

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com say the tower was built in 1940. The Oregon lookouts site says it was completed in 1933 and that 1940 is the year the lookout became a fire-weather station. The story gives both dates and does not pick one.
The register and firelookout.com say destroyed in 1953; the Oregon lookouts site says removed. The year agrees.
The register says removed in 1972 and firelookout.com says destroyed in 1972. Neither says which structure this refers to, so the story reports the date and its uncertainty.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: L-4 design, 7.6 m (25 ft) height, gone status, FFLOS US 1050. The build-year conflict (1933 vs 1940) is the main open question; the story reports both. The Crane Mountain replacement has its own FFLOS record (Crane Mountain Lookout Site, Lake County, US 1014) whose current condition was not checked. No photo with a usable image URL was retrieved. No access information found.
